gpu_probe.limitations: 26 separate timestamped pass series; nested/concurrent timings cannot be summed into total GPU frame latency. DRM VRAM/GTT bytes are residency counters, not GPU time/utilization.
gpu_probe.mode: separate instrumented diagnostic probe, not the uninstrumented A/B matrix

production_audit.journal: Final sparse block/object maps reused during validation; unique block coordinates get indexed lookup, duplicate block payloads fall back to historical any-match validation and last stored value. Object/hold indexes refresh once after final imported metadata; normal record refresh stays immediate; fallible block/fluid updates resynchronize indexes before returning errors. No geometry/radius/quality or protocol changes.
production_audit.minimap: Only native season_cycle/frame_rotation are omitted from HTML JSON serialization. Separate frame_style/cardinal/text fields remain serialized. Calendar binder directly consumes continuous native values; integration test covers 120 uniform updates plus genuine clock text update.
production_audit.tooltip: QueryState caching is present in final source, but was also retained when the native baseline was built with only journal/minimap optimizations reverted. It is baseline-common/preexisting work for this A/B, not evidence of an additional measured O07 fix.

queues_uploads.after_flight_interval_30s: Inspect native flight interval for true measured-window upload volume; status peak/deferred fields in final summary include startup.
queues_uploads.meaning: deferred_upload_batches is a cumulative count of deferral decisions, not final queue length or lost geometry; peak_admitted values measure admitted CPU geometry, not GPU stall time. 240 pending render/collision acks are counts of intermediate acknowledgment events before downstream publication, not a queue depth of 240.
queues_uploads.quality_evidence: Static clear/placement keep11792 loaded+7015 rendered sections and100340 represented props. Village/rain keep11876 loaded+7259 rendered and198927 represented props. Flight endpoint varies slightly because actual movement runs against wall time; do not claim bit-identical geometry.
queues_uploads.worst_context_after: Clear/flight/village/placement worst sampled frames had zero preceding terrain/prop generation jobs and zero admitted upload vertices; rain worst had 72172 vertices. Context is preceding-frame correlation, not a bottleneck attribution.

These overlap/nest and leave substantial unattributed Update work; no proven layout cause. Earlier observer-timestamp confound must not be assumed to explain the spike.

Worker composition maxima40-45ms (and141ms before placement) are asynchronous job durations including startup, not main-thread frame durations.

resource_limits.not_proven: No multi-hour leak/VRAM stability or hardware-wide frame floor is established by24/35-second windows. A05 remains separate.
resource_limits.observed: Final snapshot RSS is higher after in all six cases (roughly1-4%). VRAM peaks vary both directions; no measured general memory reduction. Inventory retains36 new preview images and stable20269 mesh assets across closed/open/closed; one cycle cannot prove bounded long-run behavior.
resource_limits.wall_time: Setup duration differs, especially rain:152.655s before vs174.739s after with same24s sample. Whole-process user/system CPU totals and peak residency therefore are not pure sample-window performance comparisons.
